name: YouTube
summary: Limit behavioral profiling by pausing watch history and disabling ad personalization.

settings.name: Watch History
settings.impact: YouTube watch history feeds Google's behavioral ad profiles. Pausing or auto-deleting reduces the depth of data used for targeting across all Google services.
settings.source: MyPrivacy.Blog: 'YouTube Privacy Configuration: A 2025 Technical Guide'; EFF Opt-Out October

settings.name: Search History
settings.impact: YouTube search queries reveal sensitive interests — health concerns, political views — and are stored indefinitely by default, fueling recommendations and ad targeting.

settings.name: Ad Personalization
settings.impact: YouTube ad targeting draws on search history, location, and watch history. Disabling this switches YouTube to contextual ads based on video topic only.
settings.source: EFF Opt-Out October; Google My Ad Center documentation

settings.name: Incognito Mode
settings.impact: Incognito mode prevents the current session's views and searches from being linked to your account history without permanently affecting your recommendations.

settings.name: Delete Existing Activity
settings.impact: Turning off future tracking does not remove past data. Google stores years of watch and search history that can reveal sensitive personal patterns.
